fact: The Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy inaugurated the National Digital Addressing Steering Committee to oversee the National Digital Addressing Project, under the National Digital Addressing Policy 2023.
Kanifing Municipal Council's GIS head says its digital address system, using Google Plus Codes displayed on compound gates, is in place across the municipality.
KMC officials say the council is implementing a street-naming initiative introducing sequential street numbers.
KMC says the Plus Codes are integrated into its property rates database and compliance mapping system, and emergency personnel are being trained to use them for navigation.

Kanifing Municipal Council launched the project Leveraging Digital Addresses for Evidence-Based Policymaking in Kanifing, funded by FID, introducing a digital addressing system for waste, property tax and urban services.
